title: 第3章 失败的布莱克本之旅第4章 伍尔弗汉普顿
content_zh:
第003章 失败的布莱克本之旅
决定之后，第二天，王利便带着足球学校的教练托姆.史蒂芬的介绍信，启程前往布莱克本市。
托姆.史蒂芬年轻时是英格兰的著名球星，退役后便担任教练，有很强的人脉关系。在王利离开足球学校时，有些可惜这个有才华的孩子，便写了一封介绍信给他，这样之前的王利才能顺利的前往各个中小俱乐部参加试训，不过原来的王利却没有多少交际能力，这封介绍信并不能带给他成功。
王利很感谢身体前任主人留给他的宝贵财富，这让他方便了很多，如果没有这封介绍信，他的试训请求也很难得到各个青年队的同意。
布莱克本市是英格兰兰开夏郡的自治城镇。位于兰开夏本宁丘陵区，距曼彻斯特西北约三十二千米处，人口约十七万。
虽然只是一个城镇，但它却有着自己的骄傲，那便是布莱克本足球队。
布莱克本足球俱乐部（BlackburnRoversFootballClub）成立于1875年，是1888年足球联盟成立的创始成员，自1890年开始便以伊活公园球场为其主场。
在2000－2001赛季，布莱克本队顺利的晋级英超联赛，回到英超首赛季（2001－02年）便排名第十位，并夺得布莱克本历史首次的联赛杯冠军。在格雷姆.索内斯带领下布莱克本在2002－03年赛季继续进步，取得第六位并且连续两年晋身欧洲足协杯。
可以说，现在的布莱克本队虽然还不能够称霸整个英格兰，但也处于如日中天之中。
王利到达之后，就向门卫出示了推荐信，要求见青年队主教练斯波.格尔特。
在见到这位四十多岁的年轻教练之后，他便说明了这次的目的。
斯波.格尔特对王利这种拿着XX人推荐信来参加试训的球员都十分轻视，他认为阿森纳足球学校有实力的球员早已经被阿森纳青年队挑选光了，所以他并不十分看好这位长的十分瘦弱的东方人。
不过托姆.史蒂芬的面子还是要给的，所以他就随便找了一个工作人员，带着王利去做一些基础测试。
王利也发觉了斯波.格尔特眼中的傲慢，即使自己能进入布莱克本青年队，在这种教练手下训练也肯定不会受到重视，看来这次的布莱克本之旅只能以失败告终了。
但他还是跟着工作人员参加了测试，他也想看看自己的能力到底能够达到什么程度。
英格兰超级联赛的俱乐部确实有强大的底蕴，即使是实力处于垫底位置的布莱克本队，这种体能测试以及耐力测试也都是十分正规、科学的。
经过了两个多小时的测试，王利已经汗流浃背了，他分别参加了体能测试、耐力测试、带球折返跑以及速度测试，不过他自己也知道，这些测试也只有带球折返跑一项的数据很不错，其他也只是刚刚合格而已。
不过，他也并没有因此而懊恼，因为他并没有发挥多少实力。斯波.格尔特这个人他心里是十分讨厌的，无论是谁不受重视都会产生这种情绪吧，只看这位年轻教练的神态，他便有些了解了整个布莱克本俱乐部目前的状态。
也许是去年的英超联赛第六位的好成绩已经腐蚀了他们的上进心，也许是布莱克本的青年军确实有些实力，也许...
不论结果如何，王利已经决定去其他俱乐部试试了，反正以他的实力不论去哪里都无所谓。

果然，当那名工作人员把王利的成绩表递给斯波.格尔特的时候，他只是粗略扫了一眼，便对他说了些什么。
那名工作人员便回来对王利说道：“你的成绩虽然不错，但布莱克本青年队目前前场已经非常拥挤了，所以并不需要补充任何前锋队员了。”说完，他歉意的看了看他，然后就转身走了回去。
王利也没有对此说些什么，只是无所谓的摊了摊手，便朝着布莱克本俱乐部大门外走去，他还要去找家旅馆，然后明天继续他的‘试训之旅’...
斯波.格尔特在一片小足球场上来回走着，偶尔便指导下场上的队员的训练。
那名工作人员回来对他交代之后，他笑了笑，道：“阿莱克斯，这种球员下次不要理会，都没有入选阿森纳青年队，能有什么水平...那种少年足球学校的天才们早已经被阿森纳队挑光了...”
阿莱克斯满脸疑惑的点了点头，迟疑了下，还是问道：“那么格尔特教练，刚才那名球员的测试数据也确实很不错，尤其是带球折返跑的速度，几乎超过英超联赛主力前锋的平均水平，为什么不让他试试呢？”他想问这个问题很久了，本来测试之后，他还觉得布莱克本又要有一个天才加入了，但结果却并不如他所想。
斯波.格尔特微皱了下眉头，拿起手中的测试成绩表看了看。
“百米速度11秒37，25米带球折返2周，时间15秒07...”
果然是天才的数据，百米速度到是没什么，25米折返带球100米，居然只用了15秒多，要知道，他手下的青年队天才前锋克鲁斯.奥马尔的数据才只有19秒多而已。
不过，为了保持威信，他还是强硬的说道：“这种天才多的是，没什么好奇怪的，如果他在来的话，便给他一个机会吧。”扬了扬头，便缓缓的向球场中心走去。
阿莱克斯楞了楞，看着斯波.格尔特的背影自语道：“这种天才很多？真的是这样么...”
斯波.格尔特心里确实是有些后悔的，刚才的东方人虽然身体有些瘦弱，但身体可以炼出来，天生的球感却是很难提高，如果这种球员在自己手下的话，他敢保证两年后便是又一个出色的速度型边锋。
“如果他在来的话，一定要把握住机会！”在一个没人的角落，斯波.格尔特狠狠的说道。
可惜，机会永远和他擦身而过了...
content_en:
Chapter 003 The failed trip to Blackburn
After making the decision, Wang Li set off for Blackburn the next day with a letter of introduction from football school coach Tom Stephen.
Thom Stephen was a famous star in England when he was young. After retiring, he became a coach and has strong personal connections. When Wang Li left the football school, he felt sorry for this talented child, so he wrote a letter of introduction to him, so that the previous Wang Li could successfully go to various small and medium-sized clubs to participate in trial training. However, the original Wang Li did not have much communication skills, and this letter of introduction could not bring him success.
Wang Li is very grateful for the precious wealth left to him by the previous owner of his body, which made it a lot more convenient for him. Without this letter of introduction, it would be difficult for his request for trial training to be agreed to by various youth teams.
Blackburn is a borough in Lancashire, England. It is located in the Pennine Hills area of ​​Lancashire, about 32 kilometers northwest of Manchester, with a population of about 170,000.
Although it is just a town, it has its own pride, which is the Blackburn Rovers Football Team.
Blackburn Rovers Football Club was founded in 1875 and was a founding member of the Football League in 1888. It has used Ewood Park as its home stadium since 1890.
In the 2000-2001 season, the Blackburn team successfully promoted to the Premier League. In the first season of returning to the Premier League (2001-02), they ranked tenth and won the League Cup for the first time in Blackburn's history. Under the leadership of Graeme Souness, Blackburn continued to improve in the 2002-03 season, finishing sixth and qualifying for the UEFA Cup for two consecutive years.
It can be said that although the current Blackburn team is not yet able to dominate the entire England, it is still at its peak.
After Wang Li arrived, he showed his letter of recommendation to the guard and asked to see the youth team coach Spoel Geert.
After meeting the young coach, who was in his forties, he explained his purpose this time.
Spoel Gert despises players like Wang Li who come to trial training with letters of recommendation from XX people. He believes that all the capable players from the Arsenal Football School have been selected by the Arsenal youth team, so he is not very optimistic about this very thin orientalist.
However, Thom Stephen still had to give face, so he randomly found a staff member and took Wang Li to do some basic tests.
Wang Li also noticed the arrogance in Spoel Geert's eyes. Even if he could enter the Blackburn youth team, training under such a coach would definitely not be taken seriously. It seemed that this trip to Blackburn could only end in failure.
But he still took part in the test with the staff. He also wanted to see how far his abilities could reach.
The clubs in the English Premier League do have a strong foundation. Even for the Blackburn team, which is at the bottom, this kind of physical fitness test and endurance test are very formal and scientific.
After more than two hours of testing, Wang Li was already sweating profusely. He took part in the physical fitness test, endurance test, return run with the ball, and speed test. However, he also knew that in these tests, only the return run with the ball had very good data, and the other tests were just qualified.
However, he was not upset because he didn't show much strength. He hates Spoel Geert in his heart. No matter who is not taken seriously, he will have this feeling. Just looking at the young coach's demeanor, he has some understanding of the current state of the entire Blackburn club.
Maybe last year's sixth-place finish in the Premier League has corroded their ambition, maybe Blackburn's youth army does have some strength, maybe...
Regardless of the resultAnyway, Wang Li has decided to try other clubs. Anyway, with his ability, it doesn't matter where he goes.
Sure enough, when the staff member handed Wang Li's transcript to Spoel Geert, he only glanced at it briefly and then said something to him.
The staff member came back and said to Wang Li: "Although your results are good, the frontcourt of the Blackburn youth team is already very crowded, so there is no need to add any forward players." After saying that, he looked at him apologetically, then turned and walked back.
Wang Li didn't say anything about this, he just spread his hands indifferently and walked towards the door of Blackburn Rovers Club. He still wanted to find a hotel, and then continue his 'trial training trip' tomorrow...
Spoel Geert walked back and forth on a small football field, occasionally guiding the training of the players on the field.
After the staff member came back to explain to him, he smiled and said: "Alex, ignore this kind of player next time. He has not been selected for the Arsenal youth team. What level can he have... The geniuses in the youth football school have already been selected by the Arsenal team..."
Alex nodded with confusion on his face, hesitated for a moment, and then asked: "Coach Gert, the test data of the player just now is indeed very good, especially the speed of running back and forth with the ball, which is almost higher than the average level of the main forwards in the Premier League. Why not let him try?" He had wanted to ask this question for a long time. After the test, he thought that another genius would join Blackburn, but the result was not what he thought.
Spo Geert frowned slightly, picked up the test score sheet in his hand and looked at it.
"The speed of 100 meters is 11 seconds 37, and the 25 meters dribbling back for 2 weeks, the time is 15 seconds 07..."
It is indeed a genius's data. The speed of 100 meters is nothing. It only takes more than 15 seconds to dribble the ball from 25 meters to 100 meters. You must know that the data of Cruz Omar, the talented forward of his youth team, is only more than 19 seconds.
However, in order to maintain his prestige, he still said forcefully: "There are many such geniuses, it's not surprising. If he comes, give him a chance." He raised his head and walked slowly towards the center of the stadium.
Alex was stunned, looking at Spo Geert's back and muttering to himself: "Are there many such geniuses? Is this really true..."
Spoel Geert did have some regrets in his heart. Although the Oriental just now was a little thin, his body can be tempered, but his natural ball sense is difficult to improve. If this kind of player is under his hands, he can guarantee that he will be another outstanding speed winger in two years.
"If he comes, you must seize the opportunity!" In a deserted corner, Spo Geert said fiercely.
Unfortunately, the opportunity passed him by forever...
